I found it interesting. For the most part, I always thought that Yaldabaoth was less powerful than the Scarlet King. Then again, there is no canon.

Also, are you trying to imply that Goran is the true identity of SCP-2317? Just curious.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Hey, folks. I present my first ever attempt at a Serpent's Hand article. Also it is tragically a cold post for no one commented. I'm not sure if I nailed the tone since Serpent Hand article seem to vary in tone.1

I tried to some world building and what not. Not sure how it would be received. If you have any criticisms I am glad to hear it.

Yeah. Enjoy I guess.

Edit: Just got some critique from Gabriel Jade and some brief edits will be made shortly. Thanks Jade!

Edits are done. Special thanks to Gabriel Jade!
